43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
301 days + 6 days = 307 days.  
Add 307 days to 1894-04-10.  

1894 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days from April 10 to end of April: 30 - 10 = 20 days.  
Remaining days after April: 307 - 20 = 287 days.  

May (31) → 256 left  
June (30) → 226 left  
July (31) → 195 left  
August (31) → 164 left  
September (30) → 134 left  
October (31) → 103 left  
November (30) → 73 left  
December (31) → 42 left  

Remaining 42 days into 1895: January 31 days → 11 days left.  
February 1895 is not leap (1895 not divisible by 4) → 28 days, but we only need 11 days into February.  
So February 11, 1895.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1895-02-11
